subtitles.dashboard: For team-project and study squads · based on mock user Lee Tt. (Portfolio mock data)

subtitles.backlog: A pool of items before they enter the board. Shows priority and assignee only — core/schema lands after wires.
subtitles.metrics: Numbers and bars only — real charts and aggregations land after core integration. Snapshot layout for portfolio.
subtitles.retro: KPT block mock — anonymity, voting, and timelines will be wired after retro design is done.
subtitles.inbox: List of mentions, deadlines, and file notifications. Push and real-time will replace this once infra is wired.
subtitles.dm: 1:1 and group DM wireframe layout only — no send, receive, or storage.
subtitles.huddle: Pre-voice/video Slack-style mini bar, participants, and controls only — no WebRTC or signaling.
subtitles.meetingSummary: Goal: huddle-based transcripts, AI summaries, and action extraction (A2UI). STT, models, and storage are pre-integration — wireframe only.

survey.pageDescription: You can respond anonymously without signing in.
survey.formDescription: Tell us briefly about times your team collaboration got stuck. About 3 minutes, anonymous. All responses are used only for Conflow product decisions.
survey.q1: 1. Which of the following best describes you? *
survey.orgPlaceholder: e.g., SNU CS / SOPT cohort 35 / company name
survey.q4: 4. In your last team project, how often were you in a situation where you didn't know who was stuck where? *
survey.q5: 5. How severe was the impact on the team? * (1: none — 5: very severe)
survey.q6: 6. Three hardest things in your last team project (free response)
survey.topPainPlaceholder: e.g., 1) didn't know who was doing what 2) the stuck person didn't speak up 3) ...
survey.topPainHelper: Write what HAPPENED, not the solutions.
survey.q7: 7. Collaboration tools you use today (all that apply)
survey.q8: 8. (Operators/founders only) Have you ever missed a demo day or milestone because you couldn't find a team or member whose progress had stopped?
survey.q9: 9. (Operators/founders only) How much would you pay for a team-progress visibility tool? (per semester/quarter)
survey.q10: 10. If a "team work visibility tool" existed, how likely are you to try it next semester or project? * (1: not at all — 5: very likely)
survey.followupLabel: I am willing to join a follow-up interview (20–30 min). You can contact me by email.
survey.validationRequiredAll: Please complete the required items (frequency / severity / intent).
survey.successBody: Your responses directly inform what Conflow builds.
survey.successFollowup: Since you opted in for a follow-up interview, we will be in touch soon.

retroMock.context: Conflow team · Week 3 retro summary (portfolio mock)
retroMock.wireNote: The real retro will include a voting and anonymous board, etc. Right now just the layout.
retroMock.keep1: Dailies stayed short, so focus time was protected.
retroMock.keep2: Shared doc templates sped up meeting-note cleanup.
retroMock.problem1: Priorities sometimes only converge 2–3 days before the deadline.
retroMock.problem2: Long review wait times delay starting the next task.
retroMock.try1: Wednesday-morning mini sync sharing just "this week's 3 deadlines".
retroMock.try2: Funnel blockers into a single tag and one Slack thread.
